world.title: US-Iran War Live: US to begin enforcing maritime blockade on Iran from Tuesday amid Gulf tensions
world.summary: The US plans to enforce a maritime blockade on Iran starting Tuesday amid escalating tensions. Both nations have exchanged missile and drone strikes, with Iran claiming to close the Strait of Hormuz. The conflict has affected several Gulf nations and disrupted energy corridors, raising oil prices. Diplomatic efforts to resolve the situation are ongoing, but violence continues.

world.title: Ex-Iran President under house arrest over Israel plot to regime change
world.summary: Former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad is reportedly under house arrest following allegations of secret contacts with Israeli intelligence aimed at regime change in Iran. The New York Times detailed unverified claims of meetings in Hungary and a failed extraction plan. Ahmadinejad, known for his strong anti-Israel stance during his presidency, has not publicly responded to these allegations.

world.title: Middle East crisis: US to resume naval blockade of Iranian ports, warns vessels of interception
world.summary: The United States will reinstate a maritime blockade on Iran starting Tuesday, focusing on vessels entering or leaving Iranian ports and coastal regions. This decision comes amid rising tensions between Washington and Tehran. The U.S. has warned that it will intercept any vessels violating the blockade, signaling a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict between the two nations.

business.title: Satya Nadella has issued a shocking warning to companies using AI
business.summary: Satya Nadella has raised concerns among companies using AI, highlighting fears that major AI labs selling proprietary models may pose significant risks. This apprehension is prevalent in Silicon Valley, where enthusiasts worry these models could act like Trojan horses, potentially undermining security and control. The debate over AI's downsides continues to intensify as these issues gain attention.

business.title: Gold price crashes as Waller warning sparks Fed hike fears
business.summary: Gold prices (XAU/USD) fell sharply on Monday, dropping nearly 3% following comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller. Waller indicated that if the Consumer Price Index (CPI) increases this week, the Federal Reserve may need to consider raising interest rates. This warning has heightened concerns about potential monetary policy changes, impacting investor sentiment and gold market dynamics.

business.title: Trade Setup for July 14: Top 15 things to know before the opening bell
business.summary: The Nifty 50 index must break the 23,800-24,300 range to determine its direction. Sustaining above 24,300 may lead to gains towards 24,400-24,500, while falling below 23,800 could result in consolidation. On July 13, the index rebounded from the 24,000 level, closing flat with a positive bias, following several positive closes in recent sessions.

technology.title: Apple iPhone gets iOS 27 public beta with Siri AI and up to 80% performance improvements
technology.summary: Apple has released the public beta of iOS 27 for iPhone users, featuring new enhancements like Siri AI and performance improvements of up to 80%. Users can also customize Liquid Glass. The final version of iOS 27 is anticipated to launch in September or October. Siri AI is designed to function similarly to ChatGPT and OpenClaw.

technology.title: Apple iPhone Ultra and 2026 Foldable Launch Set for September 8
technology.summary: Apple is set to reveal the iPhone Ultra on September 8, with indications that a foldable model may launch in 2026. Findings in the iOS 27 code suggest features for adjusting the folding angles, indicating Apple's careful preparation for this technology. This announcement is anticipated to generate significant interest among tech enthusiasts and industry observers.

technology.title: New CrashStealer malware poses as Apple crash reporting tool
technology.summary: A new macOS malware named CrashStealer disguises itself as Apple's crash-reporting tool. It is designed to steal sensitive information, including user credentials, keychain data, and cryptocurrency wallets. Researchers began monitoring CrashStealer in May, noting its potential threat to users. The malware's deceptive nature raises concerns about cybersecurity, particularly for those using Apple devices.

sports.title: Which team are you rooting for now at World Cup 2026?
sports.summary: Spain, Argentina, England, and France are the last four teams competing in the semi-finals of World Cup 2026. These matches will take place this week, determining which two teams will advance to the final. SB Nation is conducting a poll to gauge fan support for the remaining teams, inviting readers to share their current favorites.

sports.title: FIDE Transforms 2027 World Cup Format
sports.summary: FIDE has announced a significant change to the format of the 2027 World Cup and Women's World Cup. Instead of large knockout tournaments featuring 206 and 107 players, the final stage will now consist of only 16 qualifiers competing in a knockout format. This new structure aims to streamline the competition and enhance the viewing experience for fans.

sports.title: Fleming exit may lead to wider CSK shake-up
sports.summary: Chennai Super Kings' long-serving head coach Stephen Fleming has departed, described by management as a mutual parting of ways. His exit may signal further changes within the CSK coaching setup. The team is evaluating its structure, and additional adjustments could be forthcoming as they look to improve performance and adapt to new strategies in the upcoming seasons.

health.title: Asia-Pacific Roundup: India cuts prices of more than 30 drugs and biologics
health.summary: India’s National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has implemented price cuts for over 30 drugs and biological products following a revision of the country’s drug pricing legislation. This move aims to enhance affordability and accessibility of essential medications for the population. The government emphasizes the importance of regulating drug prices to ensure public health and welfare in India.

health.title: Gujarat govt confirms two more Chandipura deaths, awaits 8 lab reports
health.summary: The Gujarat government has confirmed two additional suspected deaths from the Chandipura virus, raising concerns as surveillance efforts increase. Out of 19 samples tested, seven returned positive, while results for eight samples remain pending. In response, the government has intensified fogging and sandfly control measures to mitigate the spread of the virus and identify potential cases more effectively.

health.title: Two suspected Chandipura deaths in Panchmahal, govt steps up surveillance
health.summary: Two suspected deaths from the Chandipura virus were reported in Panchmahal district within 24 hours, leading the state government to enhance surveillance and expedite laboratory testing. Health officials are tracking 13 suspected cases in the area. The situation has raised concerns, prompting increased monitoring to prevent further spread of the virus among the local population.

science.title: ‘Sunlight on demand’: U.S. approves test of giant space mirror to redirect sunlight
science.summary: The U.S. has approved an experimental satellite project featuring a large mirror intended to explore the feasibility of "sunlight on demand." This satellite aims to reflect sunlight onto specific locations on Earth. The Federal Communications Commission issued a license for the project, which seeks to determine the practicality and effectiveness of redirecting sunlight for various applications.

science.title: Pluto has six confirmed landslides now, and their unusually long runouts are giving scientists a clue about how icy worlds move
science.summary: Scientists have confirmed six landslides on Pluto, identified through enhanced images from NASA's New Horizons spacecraft. The landslides exhibit unusually long runouts, providing insights into the movement of icy worlds. The images were created by combining data from the Long Range Reconnaissance Imager and the Ralph instrument, taken during the spacecraft's close flyby nearly 11 years ago.

science.title: Atlantic expedition captures rare footage of a ghostly barreleye fish with a see-through head
science.summary: Scientists have captured rare footage of a barreleye fish in the Atlantic Ocean, showcasing its transparent dome-like head alive in the wild for the first time. This discovery highlights the ocean's unexplored mysteries, revealing that even in well-studied areas, unique species remain elusive. The footage serves as a reminder of the diverse life forms inhabiting the deep sea.

entertainment.title: Anupam Kher on Naseeruddin Shah's resurfaced 'clown' remark: We respect each other
entertainment.summary: Actor Anupam Kher responded to Naseeruddin Shah's resurfaced "clown" remark, emphasizing their mutual respect despite past differences. Kher noted that they have met and hugged, reinforcing their camaraderie. He suggested that the revival of the six-year-old video was intended to target him following his recent comments about the Ram Temple, framing it as an attempt to troll him.

entertainment.title: Your Horoscope for the New Moon in Cancer
entertainment.summary: The New Moon in Cancer encourages self-acceptance and personal growth. It is a period for rejuvenation and manifestation, inviting individuals to address areas of lack in their lives. This lunar phase promotes the arrival of new experiences, relationships, or possessions. Emphasizing the importance of making space for fresh beginnings, it encourages embracing one’s flaws and pursuing positive changes.

entertainment.title: Lock Upp 2: After announcing divorce from Gaurav Khanna, Akanksha Chamola opens up about becoming 'Asexual'
entertainment.summary: Akanksha Chamola announced her divorce from Gaurav Khanna during the premiere of Lock Upp season 2. In a subsequent episode, she revealed her identification as asexual. This disclosure was made while discussing her personal journey and experiences on the show. The revelations have sparked conversations about relationships and identity among viewers and participants in the reality series.
